title: Open Mic @ Fox & Goose Public House
event_description: Sacramento's longest-running open mic hosted by Dave Baldwin. Lottery-based system ensures fair performance order. Musicians perform 3 songs each with featured artist closing. All genres welcome.
event_venue_information:
Fox & Goose Public House

Historic English-Style Pub and Music Venue

Located within the Fuller Building and opened in 1975 - Fox & Goose has become a Sacramento institution. This authentic English-style pub serves breakfast - lunch - and dinner alongside a carefully curated selection of wines - beers - and cocktails. The building itself dates to 1913 and maintains an old-factory-brick aesthetic that adds character to every performance.

Live Music Programming

The venue hosts live music five nights per week - anchored by Monday's legendary open mic night that has run continuously for over 30 years. Weekend performances feature varied bands across multiple genres. Tuesday evenings feature Pub Quiz trivia night - creating a full week of community engagement and entertainment.

Dining and Atmosphere

The pub serves traditional English fare including fish and chips - bangers and mash - and olallieberry scones for breakfast alongside American classics. The intimate layout creates a warm - welcoming atmosphere where regulars and newcomers alike feel at home. Many seats face the performance area - though the vintage architecture creates interesting sight lines throughout the space.

title: Open Mic @ Old Ironsides
event_description: Long-running open mic in Sacramento's oldest bar. Sign-ups begin at 8:30 PM with performances starting at 9 PM. Intimate venue known for supportive atmosphere and quality sound.
event_venue_information:
Old Ironsides

Sacramento's Historic Music Venue

Established in 1934 with the first liquor license issued in Sacramento County after Prohibition - Old Ironsides holds the distinction of being Sacramento's oldest continuously operating bar. The family-owned establishment has evolved from a neighborhood watering hole for politicians into one of the city's premier small-scale music venues - with a capacity of 150 people.

Live Music Heritage

Old Ironsides hosts live music Thursday through Saturday nights - featuring local and touring acts across rock - indie - punk - and alternative genres. The venue gained legendary status in the 1990s when the next generation of the Kanelos family transformed it into a nightclub. Wednesday night open mics have become a staple - while the LIPSTICK indie rock dance party has run monthly for over 20 years - drawing lines around the building.

Venue Character

The intimate brick-walled space features excellent acoustics and a stage in the adjoining showroom. The venue maintains its dive bar charm while providing professional sound quality. Tuesday nights feature karaoke - and the venue previously served lunch with Greek and Italian influenced home-style cooking. The building's 88-year history is evident in every corner - creating an authentic Sacramento experience.

title: Open Mic @ Torch Club
event_description: Semi-acoustic open mic at Sacramento's premiere blues club. Musicians perform 2-3 songs in first-come first-served slots. Host provides board mix recordings for performers who bring flash drives.
backline: PA System - Mics - Board Mix Recording available
event_venue_information:
Torch Club

Sacramento's Premiere Blues Venue Since 1934

Established in 1934 - the same year Prohibition ended - Torch Club stands as one of Sacramento's oldest bars and the city's undisputed home for blues music. The intimate 75-100 person capacity venue creates an up-close experience where audiences connect directly with performers. The club's commitment to showcasing both local and national blues - jazz - funk - and Americana acts has made it a destination for serious music lovers.

Weekly Music Programming

Live music fills the Torch Club Wednesday through Sunday - with performances often extending to Sunday afternoons. Wednesday evenings from 6:00-8:00 PM feature the popular semi-acoustic open mic - welcoming musicians to share 2-3 songs in an encouraging environment. Sunday afternoons host blues jam sessions where musicians gather to improvise and collaborate. The venue's sound system and acoustics have earned consistent praise from both performers and audience members.

Blues Club Tradition

The Torch Club has hosted legends including Terry Hanck - Janiva Magness - Mark Hummel - Chris Cain - and countless other national touring acts alongside Sacramento's finest local musicians. House bands including The Lew Fratis Trio - Jimmy Pailer & the Prophets - and Aaron King Trio maintain the venue's authentic blues tradition. The dance floor welcomes dancers - and the bar serves quality drinks in a laid-back atmosphere where the music always takes center stage.

title: Open Mic @ Kupros Craft House
event_description: Relaxed open mic for musicians - comedians - and poets in a historic Craftsman home. Supportive atmosphere with craft beers and elevated bar food. Sign-ups at 7:30 PM with all-ages welcome until 10 PM.
event_venue_information:
Kupros Craft House

Midtown's Premier Craft Bar in a Historic Setting

Situated in a beautifully preserved 1910 two-story Craftsman building - Kupros Craft House embodies the charm and character of Midtown Sacramento. The venue's Victorian decor - polished wood accents - and stained glass fixtures create a warm - inviting atmosphere that feels like a second home to regulars. The unique architecture includes the only upstairs balcony in Midtown - plus a spacious front porch perfect for Sacramento's mild evenings.

Craft Beverages and Elevated Cuisine

Kupros features an extensive selection of craft beers and hand-crafted cocktails alongside a menu of elevated bar classics made with fresh local ingredients. Popular dishes include buffalo cauliflower bites - chicken sandwiches - and their famous Cobb salad. Weekend brunch draws crowds for generous mimosa pitchers and fluffy French toast. The kitchen focuses on quality ingredients and creative preparations that exceed typical bar food expectations.

Community Events and Entertainment

Beyond Tuesday open mics - Kupros hosts trivia nights and live music throughout the week. The venue maintains an all-ages policy until 10 PM - making it accessible to younger performers and families. Open mic nights welcome musicians - comedians - and poets in a supportive environment where performers can build confidence before moving to larger stages. The combination of great food - quality drinks - and genuine community spirit makes Kupros a Midtown favorite.
